snippet.title: Ahriman's Prophecy walkthrough: 01 Introduction and Elden
snippet.description:
Ahriman's Prophecy walkthrough

As requested, it's Ahriman's Prophecy!

It's just introducing the game basically, the controls etc. and the start of the quest to get milk! That's just sad.

For you Aveyonders this game is the first one in the series. You remember in Rhen's quest there's a lady you bump into called Talia? Well she was in this game first! And you get to play as her. Devin's there too, remember him? Ahh the younger days.
Yes the graphics and the music aren't as good, but trust me, your eyes won't spontaneously combust and your ears won't melt if you play this game. It's really great, and interesting to fill in the gaps of the story in Aveyond.

For those who are new to watching my videos here's the deal. Despite how many times I've played the game I always forget where I'm going, what I'm doing aaaand I tend to die a lot... I mean A LOT (you didn't see 
it? I cut it out of the final version :P). I'm all for it if you want to correct me on something or nag me for something I left out. 
Also I tend to bugger about a fair bit, go me.

Well that's about it. I acually bothered to write a half-proper description for once! How about that eh? Don't expect any more like this by the way.
